_comment: Viewer-side image-based lighting environment. This file is fetched by the browser (app/static/js/massing-viewer.js), not embedded in the exported GLB, so it carries no weight against the GLB size budget guarded by tests/test_mesh_builder.py. Same provenance rule as the other asset manifests: CC0 only, verified on the asset's own page, source recorded here. Lives under app/static/hdri/ rather than app/static/env/ -- the repo's .gitignore has a bare 'env/' rule for Python virtualenvs that silently matches any directory named env/ at any depth, which swallowed this folder the first time.

phone_shop_1k.author: Poly Haven
phone_shop_1k.licence_verified: Poly Haven is CC0 site-wide for every asset type; confirmed on the asset page before download.
phone_shop_1k.resolution: 1k (1024x512 equirectangular), Radiance .hdr -- the smallest resolution Poly Haven publishes for this HDRI
phone_shop_1k.selection_note: Chosen over a generic studio HDRI because the reflections and ambient colour it contributes are themselves from an indoor retail-electronics space -- the nearest real-world lighting analogue to the massing model available under CC0 -- rather than a neutral photo-studio rig.
